note.summary: Boards lets you keep shared notes and checklists beside each conversation, and view or edit them either as draggable cards or as a Markdown file in your vault. It runs locally in your browser and uses a scheduled Python script on your server to clean up expired items.
touches: Your conversations and their associated board Markdown files in the vault (reads and writes via `/threads/<id>/files/boards` and `loam_thread_files`)
Your owner profile name (`/owner`) to attribute notes you add
Your server, running `expiry.py` hourly and daily on a schedule, and reading `keep-dated-lines.json` from the plugin's data folder if present
Your agents' persona prompt, adding instructions on how to format board items and metadata comments
may_change: Adds a Board button and slide-over card panel to conversation headers
Projects board Markdown files in the Files viewer so inline HTML metadata comments and YAML frontmatter are hidden while editing

Creates and updates a board Markdown file for each conversation, and automatically deletes lines whose `until YYYY-MM-DD` expiry date has passed (plus dated lines older than 14 days on the General board)
Stores unsaved board drafts temporarily in browser `sessionStorage`
worth_knowing: Requires Loam 0.2.28 or later for `thread.file`, header controls, and Markdown projection slots.
While a board is mounted in an active tab, the browser polls the server every 2.5 seconds to check for updates from agents or other tabs.

On the General board, any line starting with a `YYYY-MM-DD` date that does not have an explicit `until` date is automatically deleted after 14 days by the daily schedule, unless its SHA-256 digest is listed in `keep-dated-lines.json` in the plugin data folder.
